notes.title: Survive in Angaria : Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

A new update is available!


Now you can play with your controller!
We fixed campfire!
We fixed launch errors!


And you can play our new game Paul's World on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160880/Pauls_World/

Time to work more!
Love,
Cloaz Studio!

notes.title: Survive in Angaria: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

A new update is coming soon!


    You can loot new weapons!
    You can craft new armors!
    Also we fixed some dialogues and we are still working on achievements!


Cheers, Cloaz Studio!

notes.title: Survive in Angaria: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

A new update is available!


    Now, you can use new campfire system!
    You can cook fish!
    You can explore the island!
    You can sleep!
    You can fight with new monsters!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285543/9e9c1fa2596550f832d0fd3d3bd990d20c009769.png

Also we are working on fixing some dialogues in English.

Cheers, Cloaz Studio!
